brief:
A Palestinian family in al-Munya village reported that Jewish settlers attacked their home and farm Thursday, making off with more than 100 sheep and a vehicle, Shehab Wire reported. The family said occupation forces arrested three of its members during the raid.

The family alleged that Israeli soldiers provided protection to the settlers as they carried out the assault and theft. The incident underscores the pattern of settler violence targeting Palestinian agricultural land and property in the occupied West Bank, often with military presence at the scene.
